name: Comms, Video & Timing
description: Driver-to-pit radio (radio, car harness, helmet kit, PTT, antenna), in-car video with data overlay, and the timing transponder.

components.name: Two-way radio & car harness
components.description: UHF/VHF handheld or mobile radio in a dash/ floor mount, connected via a car harness (with amplifier for engine-noise) to the helmet kit and a steering-wheel PTT. Powered from the aux block or a PDM channel; NASA wording allows radio comms to stay live with the master OFF.
components.location: Passenger floor or door bar mount (x≈1.55, y≈0.45, z≈-0.45).

raceOptions.name: Kenwood NX-series handheld + race car harness
raceOptions.brand: Kenwood / Rugged Radios / PCI Race Radios
raceOptions.notes: Kenwood 2-pin compatible harnesses are the common standard.

installNotes: Route audio leads away from ignition and DI injector wiring to avoid noise.

components.name: Helmet kit (mic + speakers) & coil cord
components.description: Helmet-mounted boom or lip mic and speakers/earbuds, with a quick-disconnect coil cord to the car harness that pulls apart if the driver exits in a hurry.
components.location: Driver helmet; car-side connector near seat (x≈1.70, y≈0.70, z≈+0.20).

2-core shielded 24 AWG through QR connector or wireless channel

components.name: Radio antenna

components.name: In-car camera with data overlay
components.description: Forward-facing camera recording video synchronized with logger data. The AiM SmartyCam 3 Sport takes CAN data from AiM loggers (must be externally powered, 9–15 V) and overlays speed/rpm/gear/lap; other systems sync GoPro footage with MoTeC/ AiM data in post.
components.location: Cage main hoop or roof bar behind driver, looking forward over the driver's shoulder (x≈2.05, y≈1.22, z≈+0.05).

factory.name: GM Performance Data Recorder camera (windshield, in mirror area)

raceOptions.name: AiM SmartyCam 3 Sport
raceOptions.notes: 1080p, 67°/84° lens, IP65, 9–15 V, CAN to AiM devices.

raceOptions.name: GoPro + external power
raceOptions.notes: Sync in post with logger data.

installNotes: Many series require cameras to be bolted (no suction cups) and tethered.

images.title: AiM SmartyCam 3 Sport – 79.9 x 54 x 46.5 mm (Bimmerworld)

modelRef.features: Black compact housing, lens barrel on the forward face, status LED, bottom mount plate, rear power/CAN connector.

components.name: Timing transponder (MyLaps)
components.description: Active timing transponder required by most sanctioning bodies. Direct-power units (MyLaps TR2 Direct Power / X2 RaceLink Club) are wired to switched 12 V on a 2.5 A fuse with chassis ground (TR2 guide: brown +12 V, blue ground; seal unused white/black). Mount vertical, ≤ 60 cm above ground, with clear view of the track surface (no metal or carbon below it); front wheel well area is the preferred car location in the TR2 guide. Subscription-based.
components.location: Right-side front wheel well area or rocker/ floor near the front, typically passenger side (x≈0.35, y≈0.35, z≈-0.80) – confirm series requirement.

raceOptions.name: MyLaps X2 RaceLink Club transponder kit
raceOptions.notes: 7–18 V, includes M8 power cable for direct power use.

hardware.spec: M5 screws or heavy zip ties through holder

installNotes: Use a switched supply so it doesn't drain the battery, unless series requires constant power.

sources.title: MyLaps TR2 Direct Power quick start guide
